name: Phantom Image Captioner
effect: The altered model stops answering the question. It gives short, vague meta-statements ("This is a sample of how...", "This is an explanation of...") or describes a picture nobody sent, often about hands, fingers, rings, phones or pens, and
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
